quality: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent game sprite atlas for SKYBREAK, a top-down Pacific coastal arcade air combat game. Modern beautifully painted/pre-rendered miniature aircraft with rich metal materials, crisp contours, dimensional fuselages, realistic wing structure, weathered panel detail, warm top-left lighting. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN, all aircraft noses point UP, no perspective tilt, no ground, no cast shadow, no glow background, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Exactly 12 separate complete objects in an evenly spaced 4 column by 3 row grid, canvas 2048x1536, each cell 512x512 with ample transparent padding. Each object centered in its cell, fully contained. Row 1 left to right: (1) heroic ivory and petrol-blue twin-wing single prop fighter with gold wing tips and bright cyan cockpit, broad readable wings; (2) small hostile burnt-orange single-engine scout, straight wings; (3) hostile ochre swept-wing broad twin-boom raider; (4) heavy plum-colored twin-engine bomber with broad wings and short thick body. Row 2: (1) hostile pale sage-green narrow fast interceptor with long fuselage and sharply swept wings; (2) enormous steel-blue flying wing fortress with broad armored hull, central circular reactor socket and two empty engine sockets, entire fortress contained in single cell, roughly twice as wide as tall; (3) square gold supply capsule with raised double upward chevron icon, polished beveled frame; (4) square purple supply capsule with branching three-arrow icon. Row 3: (1) square green supply capsule with white medical cross; (2) whole steel-blue engine nacelle, elongated vertical mechanical housing with circular glowing turquoise turbine at center, exhaust at bottom; (3) circular armored reactor module, turquoise center with ivory radial vanes; (4) a soft white cloud puff seen from directly above, subtle gray blue underside. All props standalone. Aircraft must occupy most cell width, their propellers integrated as a subtle disc, complete silhouettes. No loose parts, no stands, no humans. Preserve a coherent classic propeller-aircraft coastal-war identity, no space ships or science fiction jets. Truly transparent background.
assets: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for SKYBREAK, a top-down Pacific coastal arcade air shooter. Beautiful detailed hand-pixeled 1990s arcade sprite art, deliberate pixel clusters, hard edges, rich limited palettes, ink outline, shaded metal panels and distinct silhouettes. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN, every aircraft nose points UP, no perspective tilt, no ground, no cast shadows, no background, no text/labels/grid lines. Exactly 12 whole separate objects in evenly spaced 4 columns by 3 rows grid, 2048x1536 canvas, each cell 512x512 with ample transparent padding. Center each object in its cell. Row 1: (1) ivory and petrol-blue heroic single prop fighter, gold wing tips, cyan canopy, broad wings; (2) hostile burnt-orange scout with straight wings; (3) ochre swept-wing twin-boom broad raider; (4) heavy plum twin-engine bomber with broad wings, thick short body. Row 2: (1) pale sage-green narrow interceptor with long fuselage and sharply swept wings; (2) steel-blue huge flying-wing fortress, broad armor, central reactor socket and two empty engine sockets, entire whole fortress in one cell, twice as wide as tall; (3) gold square pickup capsule embossed double chevron; (4) violet square pickup capsule embossed branching arrows. Row 3: (1) green square pickup capsule white cross; (2) whole steel-blue vertical elongated engine nacelle with bright turquoise round turbine, exhaust below; (3) round armored cyan reactor module with ivory radial blades; (4) small pixel cloud cluster white blue-gray. Whole sprites, consistent modest old-school pixel scale roughly 100 pixels per aircraft, do not smooth. Aircraft width fills most cell. Integrated propeller discs. No limbs or loose parts, no humans, no spaceships, no jets. Original redistributable artwork. Transparent background.
scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game background texture for a vertically scrolling TOP DOWN orthographic Pacific coastal aircraft shooter SKYBREAK. Tall 1024x1536 image, no horizon or sky, camera looks straight down at ocean. Modern hand-painted sumptuous ocean and tropical rocky coast, dark petrol-blue calm central water, subtle currents, sparse foam wavelets, aquamarine shoals. Fragmented lush islands and small rocky reefs occupy ONLY far left and far right 18 percent edges, varied irregular shapes, rich palm canopy and rock, cream surf outlining edges, small sandy coves. Central 64 percent must stay quiet dark open ocean for bright aircraft/bullets to read. Gentle top-left sun, believable sea depth. No planes, boats, buildings, weapons, projectiles, UI, text, clouds, fog, horizon or vignettes baked in. Designed for continuous vertical scrolling, top and bottom edge should both be similar quiet dark teal open ocean so they can wrap with a short soft overlap; islands are small detached forms separated by water instead of one diagonal coast. The coast must appear to pass under the moving player. No perspective, no frozen scenic vista, no big central island. Beautiful dimensional painted environmental tile with detailed shoreline but very subdued detail in middle.
